meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 用户要求项目历史报告时，Claude 会从 claude-mem 读取该项目时间线，估算规模，然后生成「Journey Into [项目名]」叙事报告并保存为 Markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求「时间线报告」「项目历史分析」「项目旅程」等，或提出类似的项目发展回顾要求时触发。

say.text: 给 tokyo 项目写一份时间线报告。
say.note: 生成叙事报告并保存为 Markdown 文件。

say.text: 分析当前项目的开发历程，输出旅程报告。
say.note: 用当前目录的名称作为项目名。

say.text: 把 my-app 的完整历史总结成一份叙事报告。
say.note: 会先估算规模并显示确认提示。

howto.what_en: When asked for a project history report, Claude reads the project's timeline from claude-mem, estimates its size, then generates a narrative 'Journey Into [project]' report and saves it as a Markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a timeline report, project history analysis, project journey, or similar project development review.

say_en.text: Write a timeline report for the tokyo project.
say_en.note: Generates Journey Into tokyo as a Markdown file.

say_en.text: Analyze the current project's development and write a journey report.
say_en.note: Uses the current directory as project name.

say_en.text: Summarize my-app's full history into a narrative report.
say_en.note: Shows an estimate and asks for confirmation.
